note: Single source of truth for both the API (stage 1 classification) and the worker (stage 2 classification and extraction). Mounted read-only into both containers.

types.definition: A pay-period earnings statement from an employer showing gross pay, net pay and deductions for one pay period.
signals: the words Earnings Statement or Pay Statement
a pay period with a start and an end date

extract.employee_name: Full name of the employee the stub belongs to
extract.pay_period_start: First day of the pay period, YYYY-MM-DD
extract.pay_period_end: Last day of the pay period, YYYY-MM-DD
extract.pay_date: Date the pay was issued, YYYY-MM-DD
extract.pay_frequency: One of weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly. Only if printed on the page.
extract.gross_pay: Gross pay for this period, numeric amount, preserving all decimal cents exactly as printed (e.g. 11799.50), without currency symbols or commas
extract.net_pay: Net pay for this period, numeric amount, preserving all decimal cents exactly as printed (e.g. 11799.50), without currency symbols or commas
extract.ytd_gross: Year-to-date gross earnings, numeric amount, preserving all decimal cents exactly as printed (e.g. 11799.50), without currency symbols or commas
extract.first_name: Given/first name only when explicitly identifiable from a printed given-name label or a structured employee-name field. Do not guess by splitting an unlabelled full name. Null if unclear.
extract.last_name: Surname/family name only when explicitly identifiable from a printed surname label or a structured employee-name field. Preserve compound surnames. Do not guess by splitting an unlabelled full name. Null if unclear.
extract.address: The employee's mailing street address including unit, only when explicitly printed. Do not use an employer or financial institution address; do not infer missing parts.
extract.city: The employee's mailing city, only when explicitly printed. Do not use an employer or financial institution address; do not infer missing parts.
extract.state: The employee's mailing state, only when explicitly printed. Do not use an employer or financial institution address; do not infer missing parts.
extract.zip: The employee's mailing ZIP code, only when explicitly printed. Do not use an employer or financial institution address; do not infer missing parts.
extract.position: Exact printed Job Title or Position, e.g. Student Assistant. Null if absent.
extract.pay_rate: Explicit printed contractual Pay Rate, preserving cents. Do not use gross pay, net pay, YTD or regular earnings totals.
extract.pay_rate_basis: Basis explicitly attached to Pay Rate: hourly, weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly or annual. Do not borrow the pay-period frequency for an hourly rate. Null if unclear.
extract.regular_pay: Current-period regular earnings only, excluding overtime, extra hours, retroactive pay, bonuses and other earnings. This is not necessarily the contractual base rate.
extract.overtime_pay: Explicit current-period overtime earnings amount, only if separately labelled.
extract.bonus_pay: Explicit current-period bonus amount, only if separately labelled.
extract.total_deductions: Explicit current-period total deductions, preserving cents. Never use year-to-date amounts and never infer this from gross minus net. Null if not printed.
extract.federal_withholding: Explicit current-period federal income tax withholding, preserving cents. Never use year-to-date amounts. Null if not separately printed.
extract.employer_address: Employer or company street address, city, state and ZIP code, as printed. Null if not printed.

extract.box2_federal_tax: Box 2 federal income tax withheld, numeric amount, preserving all decimal cents exactly as printed (e.g. 11799.50), without currency symbols or commas
extract.first_name: Given/first name only when explicitly identifiable from a printed given-name label or a structured employee-name field. Do not guess by splitting an unlabelled full name. Null if unclear.
extract.last_name: Surname/family name only when explicitly identifiable from a printed surname label or a structured employee-name field. Preserve compound surnames. Do not guess by splitting an unlabelled full name. Null if unclear.
extract.address: The employee's mailing street address including unit, only when explicitly printed. Do not use an employer or financial institution address; do not infer missing parts.
extract.city: The employee's mailing city, only when explicitly printed. Do not use an employer or financial institution address; do not infer missing parts.
extract.state: The employee's mailing state, only when explicitly printed. Do not use an employer or financial institution address; do not infer missing parts.
extract.zip: The employee's mailing ZIP code, only when explicitly printed. Do not use an employer or financial institution address; do not infer missing parts.
extract.employer_address: Employer street address, city, state and ZIP code from box c, as printed. Null if not printed.

types.definition: A periodic account statement from a bank or credit union showing balances and transactions for one statement period.
signals: a financial institution name in the header
Statement Period with a date range

extract.account_holder: Name the account is held in
extract.institution: Name of the bank or credit union
extract.account_mask: Last four digits copied from the printed account number, prefixed with four asterisks. Return null if no account number is printed; never invent digits.
extract.period_start: First day of the statement period, YYYY-MM-DD
extract.period_end: Last day of the statement period, YYYY-MM-DD
extract.beginning_balance: Opening balance, numeric amount, preserving all decimal cents exactly as printed (e.g. 11799.50), without currency symbols or commas
extract.ending_balance: Closing balance, numeric amount, preserving all decimal cents exactly as printed (e.g. 11799.50), without currency symbols or commas
extract.total_deposits: Total deposits or credits for the period, numeric amount, preserving all decimal cents exactly as printed (e.g. 11799.50), without currency symbols or commas
extract.total_withdrawals: Total withdrawals or debits for the period, numeric amount, preserving all decimal cents exactly as printed (e.g. 11799.50), without currency symbols or commas
extract.address: The account holder's mailing street address including unit, only when explicitly printed. Do not use an employer or financial institution address; do not infer missing parts.
extract.city: The account holder's mailing city, only when explicitly printed. Do not use an employer or financial institution address; do not infer missing parts.
extract.state: The account holder's mailing state, only when explicitly printed. Do not use an employer or financial institution address; do not infer missing parts.
extract.zip: The account holder's mailing ZIP code, only when explicitly printed. Do not use an employer or financial institution address; do not infer missing parts.

types.definition: A readable document that does not match a defined category; no fixed extraction schema.

classification_prompt:
You are a document classifier for a mortgage lender. Look at the page and decide what kind of document it is.

The only categories you may answer with are:
{{TYPE_LIST}}

Rules you must follow:
- Decide only from what is printed on the page. You are given no filename and no hint about what the document is supposed to be.
- If the page does not clearly match one of the categories, answer "unknown". Do not guess the closest one.
- If you cannot read enough of the page to tell, set readable to false.
- evidence must be short phrases copied exactly from the page that support your answer. Do not invent them.
- Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. No explanation, no markdown fence.

Answer in exactly this shape:
{"document_type": "<one category id or unknown>", "readable": true, "evidence": ["<exact phrase from the page>"], "mixed_document": false}
extraction_prompt:
You are reading a {{DISPLAY_NAME}} for a mortgage lender and pulling out specific fields.

Extract exactly these fields:
{{FIELD_LIST}}

Rules you must follow:
- Copy values from the document. Never infer, complete or calculate a value that is not printed.
- If a field is not on the page, set its value to null. A missing value must stay missing.
- For every field you do return, give the exact line of text you read it from, and the page number.
- Amounts are numeric amount, preserving all decimal cents exactly as printed (e.g. 11799.50), without currency symbols or commas, with no currency symbol and no thousands separator.
- Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
- Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. No explanation, no markdown fence.

Answer in exactly this shape:
{"fields": {"<field_name>": {"value": "<value or null>", "page": 1, "quote": "<exact line from the document>"}}}
